title: Red Hat Security Advisory: kpatch-patch-5_14_0-284_134_1, kpatch-patch-5_14_0-284_148_1,…
description: Red Hat has released a security advisory for a kernel live patch module targeting kernel version 5.14.0-284.134.1.el9_2. The update addresses multiple vulnerabilities in the Linux kernel components including netfilter, pppoe, bridge, packet, and xfrm subsystems. These vulnerabilities involve issues such as improper memory writes, pointer reload errors, and validation flaws. The advisory rates the security impact as Important and provides patches for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.2 variants.
